rows.label: PPP conversion factor (2017 international $ per US $)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, household final consumption (PA.NUS.PRVT.PP) and official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
source.note: South Sudan, 2017: 36.7849 South Sudanese pounds per international $ (household consumption PPP) and 113.6475 pounds per US$ (PA.NUS.FCRF); 113.6475 / 36.7849 = 3.0895 (WDI last updated 2026-10-08).

rows.explainer: How much more a US dollar buys in South Sudan than in the US, at 2017 prices (household consumption PPP over the market exchange rate).

rows.label: Crude death rate, 2024 (deaths per person-year)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: Death rate, crude (per 1,000 people), SP.DYN.CDRT.IN (UN WPP)
source.note: South Sudan, 2024: 9.821 deaths per 1,000 people (WDI last updated 2026-10-08); divided by 1,000.

rows.explainer: Deaths per person a year in the whole population, the normal rate a crisis's excess mortality is measured against.
